steps.name: Anti-Circularity
steps.detail: Monte Carlo cross-check of the exact-enumerated headline RTP (99.9720%, Step 32). Independent 30,000,000-spin Monte Carlo: base RTP 56.13% per spin + bonus contribution (trigger probability 0.4407% × avg session 99.6647× stake across 132,222 integrated trigger+session bonus sessions) → 100.06% blended. MC std error on blended RTP at this sample size is ~0.3pp (bonus heavy-tail dominated); the cross-check agrees with the enumerated value within sampling noise. Both estimates computed from operator's published per-reel weights, paytable, and cascade algorithm — no operator-supplied probability table. Pass-1 simulator uses the same gravity-fill cascade independently validated byte-exact against captured data in Step 28.

steps.name: Simulation Pass 1
steps.detail: Per-reel chi-squared (Bonferroni α=0.0017): 0/6 fails. reel 0: χ²=8.63, p=0.5672; reel 1: χ²=7.08, p=0.7176; reel 2: χ²=5.82, p=0.8300; reel 3: χ²=9.39, p=0.4956; reel 4: χ²=10.95, p=0.3613; reel 5: χ²=4.94, p=0.8954. Serial independence (n=100k payouts): lag-1 |z|=0.57 (threshold 3.14), runs p=0.9666 (threshold 0.0017). All checks within FWER-corrected thresholds.

steps.name: Pass 2 Cherry-Pick Detection
steps.detail: Forward-replay across 115 committed server seeds × 10,000 nonces (1,150,000 simulated outcomes). Each seed's early window (nonces 0..49) and late window (50..9999) chi-squared (1 d.o.f., win/no-win) against the exact enumerated win rate 45.58% from outputs/base-2pow32.json. Cherry-pick signature: early p<0.05 AND late p≥0.05. Flags: 4/115 (~6 expected by chance at 5% per-seed false-positive rate). Binomial P(X ≥ 4 | n=115, p=0.05) = 0.8321 → PASS (threshold p ≥ 0.01).
